body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Extreme-Efficiency Power Electronics Designer, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Topology search under efficiency targets). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Topology search under efficiency targets and Magnetics co-design. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Power electronics simulation program) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: simulated.
